answer_1.quote: This paper focuses on Seq2Seq (S2S) constrained text generation where a set of encoder input tokens are required to be present in the generated outputs. For example, Keyword-to-Text , Data-to-Text  and Image-to-Text
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are natural language texts that must include specified lexical constraints such as keywords, key-value pairs, or image object labels, potentially with linguistic variants.

answer_2.quote: Following the suggestions in Lin et al. (2020), we report CIDEr  and SPICE  as generated text quality metrics.

answer_4.quote: We therefore select 100 output samples from the T5 baseline and our MF model in all three tasks (300 in total). For each sample pair, we ask three annotators to judge which sample is "more human-like".
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge which sample is "more human-like" in a pairwise comparison.
